$comment: Single source of truth for the B2 configuration contract. Read by services/api/app/config/settings.py (Python, at import time) and by scripts/doctor.mjs (Node, zero-dependency, runs before the venv exists). Never duplicate this list in either file: the two used to carry their own copies behind a 'keep in sync' comment, and they drifted. `setting` is the Settings field the env var binds to; tests/test_b2_required_vars.py asserts every one of them exists.
